node.title: Re^2: Script help needed - RegEx & Hashes
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
All good points (++). One minor comment:

Please try to use consistent indentation.

From my quick eye-parse of the code, [PandaRaey] is using consistent indentation. It's just that their choice of indentation scheme ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indentation_style#Whitesmiths_style|Whitesmiths]) is unusual to see in Perl.
